# A run configured by flags, in a directory with no entry in muxt.json, keeps
# its own path types and leaves the hub file as it was: route_paths covers the
# listed packages only.

muxt generate
cp route_paths.go route_paths.go.before

cd other
muxt generate --use-receiver-type=Server
muxt check
cd ..

cmp route_paths.go route_paths.go.before
exec go build ./...
exec go test ./other

-- go.mod --
module example.com/m

go 1.22
-- muxt.json --
{
  "route_paths": {},
  "package_defaults": {
    "use_receiver_type": "Server"
  },
  "packages": {
    "example.com/m/blog": [
      {}
    ]
  }
}
-- blog/blog.go --
package blog

import "html/template"

var templates = template.Must(template.New("GET /article/{id} GetArticle(id)").Parse(`<h1>{{.Result}}</h1>`))

type Server struct{}

func (Server) GetArticle(id int) string { return "article" }
-- other/other.go --
package other

import "html/template"

var templates = template.Must(template.New("GET /other Index()").Parse(`<a id="self" href="{{.Path.Index}}">other</a>`))

type Server struct{}

func (Server) Index() string { return "other" }
-- other/other_test.go --
package other

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestAFlagsRunKeepsItsOwnPathTypes(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	var paths TemplateRoutePaths = TemplateRoutes(mux, Server{})
	if got, want := paths.Index(), "/other"; got != want {
		t.Errorf("paths.Index() = %q, want %q", got, want)
	}
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/other", nil))
	if body, want := rec.Body.String(), `id="self" href="/other"`; !strings.Contains(body, want) {
		t.Errorf("GET /other body = %q, want it to contain %q", body, want)
	}
}
